document_type: M3-G gain-aware execution gate PREREGISTERED LOCK; variant and rho are IMMUTABLE after the calibration-freeze commit (handoff Sec. 9); no further tuning allowed

gain_gate_locked.decision_rule_GA2: act iff upper end of signed-gain CI <= -rho; WIDEN: g_ci_high*0.20/M2 <= -rho; SHRINK: g_ci_low*(-0.20)/M2 <= -rho
gain_gate_locked.passthrough: HOLD_* directions keep HOLD with the raw reason code preserved
gain_gate_locked.legality_floor: acted state must remain legal under the frozen checker at the mapped arm; illegal -> fold HOLD_INVALID (M3-D audit discipline)

m2_normalizer.locked_form: base-arm EVALUATION M2 (n_eval=100k, matched CRN [seed,900001]) at the current covariance
m2_normalizer.preregistered_form: pilot-based M2_hat inside the frozen estimator (task Sec. 3: Delta_rel = g_hat*dtheta/M2_hat)
m2_normalizer.rationale: the D6 Layer-A record schema stores only per-arm evaluation M2 values; pilot M2_hat is not persisted in results/phase_m3d/layer_a/m3d_layer_a_v1.json. Both quantities estimate the SAME functional (variance mass at the current covariance); using the identical normaliser in offline calibration and in the online gate keeps the calibrated policy exactly equal to the evaluated policy.
m2_normalizer.audit_plan: pilot M2_hat is recorded in every online record as a diagnostic; the audit quantifies gate-decision agreement under the alternative normaliser.

ga2_ci_propagation.locked_form: linear propagation of the FROZEN g-CI through the sign-stable factor dtheta/M2 (upper end of signed gain)
ga2_ci_propagation.preregistered_form: per-replicate (g_r, M2_r) bootstrap propagation of Delta_rel (task Sec. 3)
ga2_ci_propagation.rationale: per-replicate arrays are not persisted in the D6 record schema; linear propagation through the frozen g-CI is the conservative CI-sign-style rule available from stored data and identical in both phases. The full per-replicate propagation is available ONLINE via bootstrap_gain_replicates and is recorded as a diagnostic for the audit.
ga2_ci_propagation.audit_plan: quantify |upper_end_linear - upper_end_per_replicate| and gate-decision agreement on the online batch.

selection_evidence_summary.rule: eligible = WIDEN recall>=0.90 AND SHRINK recall>=0.90 each (pooled, 192 trials); among eligible maximize accuracy (Acc3); tie-break balanced accuracy, macro-F1, smaller rho, GA1 before GA2
selection_evidence_summary.mechanism_note: ALL GA1 rows equal the baseline (every frozen active decision has |Delta_rel| far above 0.02 on this benchmark); GA2 converts exactly 2 over-acting WIDEN-on-HOLD trials (c004_s2_00250 seed 2030, c006_s2_00250 seed 2029) whose conservative CI upper end (~-0.0011, -0.0014) falls inside the indifference band at every locked rho; rho sensitivity is FLAT on the four-grid: all four GA2 rows coincide, so the preregistered tie-break (smaller rho) selects 0.0025.
